The Elvish Protocol

Category: Cryptography | Difficulty: Medium

Transmission Intercepted

We intercepted a message leaving Rivendell, but the encryption seems to have been corrupted by the enemy. Our scouts managed to recover a single fragment of lore along with the cipher.

"The text is bound by the Dark Lord's name, but the letters themselves have been shifted forward by the number of rings given to the Dwarf-lords."

The Ciphertext

Decrypt the following message to uncover the flag:

Esbe: OlhObaf26{iml_emzm_mvu_qdgosz_bzwqfqr_hiqkpp}
